نَفْحَةٌ An odour, whether good or bad: or a plenteous odour; differing from نَفْخَةٌ, which is a slight odour: (AHn, in L, art. نفخ:) pl. نَفَحَاتٌ. (L.) You say لَهُ نَفْحَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ, (S, L.) and خَبِيثَةٌ, (L,) It has a good, or sweet, and a bad, or foul, odour. (L.) ―
-b2- نَفْحَةٌ (tropical:) A blast, or breath, of wind. (K.) ―
-b3- نَفْحَةٌ مِنَ الصَّبَا (tropical:) A pleasant and fragrant blast of the east wind. And نفحةٌ مِنْ سَمُومٍ (tropical:) A grievous blast of hot wind. (AHeyth.) ―
-b4- نَفْحَةٌ مِنَ العَذَابِ (assumed tropical:) A part, or portion, of punishment: (S, K:) or a grievous blast of punishment: (AHeyth:) or a most violent infliction of punishment. (L.) ―
-b5- نَفْحَةٌ الدَّمِ (tropical:) The first gush of blood from a wound. (Khálid Ibn-Jembeh, L.) ―
-b6- نَفْحَةٌ (tropical:) A single churning (مَحْضَةٌ so in the A and TA: in. the CK and a MS copy of the K. مَحْضَة, with ح unpointed:) of milk. (A, K.) ―
-b7- [See 1.] ―
-b8- نَفْحةٌ (tropical:) A gift: (Msb:) [pl. نَفَحَاتٌ]. ―
-b9- لا تَزَالُ لِفُلَان نَفَحَاتٌ منَ المَعْرُوفِ (S, L) There cease not to be attributable to such a one acts of kindness, or favours. (L.) ―
-b10- تعَرَّضُوا لِنَفَحَاتِ رَحْمَةِ ٱللّٰهِ (tropical:) (TA:) see art. عرض, ?? تَعَرَّضَ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
